connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — APDCL Schedule of Tariff w.e.f. 01-04-2025 (AERC order dated 25-03-2025, Petition No. 21 of FY2024), category LT-IV 'Commercial load above 0.5 kW to 30 kW': https://www.apdcl.org/website/docs/acts_and_rules/Tariff_schedule_with_subsidy_2025-26.pdf. Full-cost energy charge shown (no state subsidy applies to this category).

PRIMARY — APDCL Schedule of Tariff w.e.f. 01-04-2025, category LT-VIII(ii) 'Small Industries Urban upto 30kW': https://www.apdcl.org/website/docs/acts_and_rules/Tariff_schedule_with_subsidy_2025-26.pdf. APDCL also offers a lower LT-VIII(i) 'Small Industries Rural' rate of ₹6.59/kWh (fixed ₹70/kW/month), not modelled here.
